title: India just hit #5 — only $220B from #4 #Shorts
description:
India's stock markets just entered the global Top 5 for the first time.

BSE+NSE market cap: $5.45 Trillion
Hong Kong (#4): $5.67 Trillion
Gap: just $220 billion — roughly 4%

What drove the jump from #7 to #5:
→ FII inflows of ₹66,302 Cr poured in during November
→ Crude oil fell 22% ($118 → $92/bbl), easing inflation
→ Taiwan's AI selloff: TAIEX fell 40,000 pts, money rotated to India

Nifty is up 6.3% in November alone.
